snippet.title: MGLN A's Portable: Gears of Destiny - Intro cutscene
snippet.description:
This is the intro to the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's Portable: Gears of Destiny.
The translation and transcription of the Romancers' Neo was acquired from here: https://theotherice.wordpress.com/2011/11/26/romancers-neo-translation/
